item_short_desc: Rothco’s Mourning Arm Band symbolizes the loss of someone you respect and honor. Wear this band over your arm as a symbol of support for fallen Police Officers, Law Enforcement Officials, and beyond.
description: Rothco’s Mourning Arm Band symbolizes the loss of someone you respect and honor. Wear this band over your arm as a symbol of support for fallen Police Officers, Law Enforcement Officials, and beyond. Made from a stretchy elasticized material with a hook & loop closure to fit over most arms.  Mourning Band can ideally be worn over your uniform shirts and or jacket. Dimensions: 2 inches wide X 15.75 inches circumference.
